about.heading: About Me
about.text1: I’m a PHP & Laravel Developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining production-ready web applications for real clients.
about.text2: My main focus is backend and full-stack web development with PHP, Laravel, MySQL, REST APIs, and modern web technologies. I enjoy turning business requirements into reliable, maintainable systems — from database design and authentication to admin dashboards, APIs, integrations, and deployment.
about.text3: I have worked on real-world projects across different business needs, including content management systems, e-commerce-related platforms, property and service management, and custom internal systems. My experience goes beyond writing code; I also work with Git, GitHub/GitLab, SEO, performance optimization, hosting, and production deployment.
about.text4: Since 2024, I have been continuously developing my Laravel expertise through real client projects and production applications.
about.text5: I’m currently expanding my full-stack skill set through the Byts4Future program, where I’m working with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Next.js, and React Native, alongside problem solving, communication, English, and teamwork.
about.text6: My goal is to grow into a well-rounded Junior Full-Stack Developer, combining my practical Laravel experience with modern JavaScript technologies to build complete, production-ready web and mobile applications.

projects.heading: Featured Projects
projects.subheading: A selection of production applications I've built and maintained.

milano.title: Milano — Restaurant Website & CMS
milano.description: A full-featured restaurant website and CMS built for Milano Pizza. Includes a complete admin dashboard for managing content, menus, pricing, and site appearance, plus bilingual support (English/Spanish) and automated backup management — built with a strong focus on maintainability and ease of use.

zakaria.title: Zakaria — Dynamic CMS & Company Website
zakaria.description: A production CMS and company website built for a company specializing in interior and decorative design. Features a flexible dashboard for managing content, sections, and text, along with advanced filtering tools — giving the client full control over the site without needing code changes.

hebra.title: HEBAR — Bilingual E-Commerce Platform
hebra.description: A bilingual (Arabic/English) storefront and admin platform for printer, ink, toner, and office supply products. Includes a full product catalog with comparison and WhatsApp checkout, QR payment confirmation, and a Filament-powered admin dashboard covering orders, SEO, and analytics.

lawfirm.title: Law Firm Management & Case Management System
lawfirm.description: A production-ready system for a law firm to manage employees, cases, and internal communication. Features case tracking with review reminders, private per-case chat rooms, granular role-based permissions, employee activity logging, and Google Drive integration for document storage.
